scope: RewindBox Pocket skins revised in place (PR #166 screen framing and PR #167 pressed controls, merged by the integration session as two separate merges): six of the seven packs of assets/skins/pocket are rebuilt by RewindBox's own generators (tools/skins/build_pocket_skins.py, build_pocket_board_originals.py, build_switch_pocket.py); none is added or removed and ps2-pocket is byte-identical. PR #166: each rebuilt pack gains screens/*.png, the opening measured on its own body image by tools/skins/screen_opening.py (alpha = where the body stays), and its info.json declares screens[0].screenCutout with outputFrame = the box of that opening; wii-pocket and gamecube-pocket also get new embedded previews. PR #167: the *-pressed.png control sprites of the three Originals and of Switch Pocket are redrawn from the same control sprites by pressed_face (the cap moves down inside its own outline). Controls, frames, touch areas and bodies are unchanged; every pixel comes from the bodies and designs already reviewed (Pocket originals, PS2 Pocket, board Originals, PS2 Pocket - Original, Switch Pocket). Console names and marks belong to their owners. No third-party artwork or font bundled. The Dolphin, ARMSX2 and MeloNX bridges change RewindBox's own skin overlay sources only (GPL-3.0-or-later, the packages' licence; no podspec change). No hosted package, dependency, framework, engine, Core or vendored native source change.
